summary: Full backend + frontend smoke tests for SmartLearn (Node/Express + Mongo + React). Wrote 41 pytest cases covering auth, dashboard, gamification, courses, AI offline mode (tutor/roadmap/quiz/flashcards/study-plan/resume/interview/doc-qa), quizzes, flashcards, planner, all content endpoints, premium entitlements, instructor RBAC, resumes, resources and search. All 41 pass (2 skipped for missing prior state). Frontend Playwright walk-through confirmed login (student + teacher), dashboard render + Start-30-min-session XP award, theme toggle, global search, roadmap generate + node status, quiz/flashcard/plan generate buttons, premium buy/read buttons, resume analyze/save, resource vault + doc-qa tab, interview simulator, coding arena nav, student cannot see Instructor nav, teacher sees Instructor Studio and can create courses, logout available via user-menu-btn, ai-inactive-banner shown on AI pages (Roadmaps, etc.). Found one CRITICAL crash bug in the backend that would take down the whole service on bad input; fixed by adding express-async-errors and a process-level rejection guard.

critical.issue: Unhandled promise rejections in async Express 4 handlers crashed the entire Node process on invalid input (e.g. bad enum value, bad ObjectId). Supervisor auto-restarted but every user got 502 during the outage. Reproduced by POST /api/instructor/courses {level:'beginner'} and POST /api/courses/notanid/enroll. Fixed by installing express-async-errors and adding process.on('unhandledRejection'/'uncaughtException') in server.js so errors flow to the existing error middleware and return 500 instead of killing the process.

minor.issue: For OWNED items the list response includes the full protectedContent field. Not a leak (user owns it) but bloats every list response; consider omitting from list and requiring GET /:id/content.

Level enum is capitalized (Beginner/Intermediate/Advanced) while the frontend/test docs suggest lowercase. Should either lowercase the enum or accept case-insensitively and validate before hitting Mongoose to return a clean 400 instead of relying on the async wrapper.
No input validation layer (Pydantic/Joi). Bad input reaches Mongoose which now returns 500. Recommend adding Joi/Zod validation and returning 400.

issues: Radix Dialog console warning: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle for accessibility'. Wrap dialog titles or add VisuallyHidden titles.
Login redirects to /app (not /dashboard as stated in spec) — works fine but spec mentions /dashboard route.

action_items: Review the express-async-errors integration and the process.on rejection guard added to /app/backend/server.js (testing agent applied a safe fix). Consider adding a Joi/Zod validation middleware on top so bad payloads return 400 instead of 500.
Add DialogTitle (or VisuallyHidden title) to Radix dialogs to remove a11y warning.
Optionally omit protectedContent from GET /api/premium list even for owned items and fetch only via /:id/content.
critical_code_review_comments: server.js originally had no protection against async handler rejections in Express 4 -> unhandled promise rejection killed the Node process. Fixed with express-async-errors.
instructor.js has 9 async handlers with zero try/catch; before the fix any validation error propagated up and crashed the process. Even with the wrapper, no route validates inputs prior to Mongoose.
premium.js returns protectedContent for owned items in the list endpoint (minor leak/bloat).
Resource type enum is ['pdf','link','doc','video'] but there is no OpenAPI/type contract shared with the frontend so easy to send invalid values.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all critical flows work, minor a11y warning only)

AI banner only renders on AI-related pages (Roadmaps, Quizzes, Flashcards, Planner, Interview, Resume) not on the plain Dashboard — that's an intentional UX choice, not a bug. logout-btn lives inside the user-menu-btn dropdown, not directly in the shell. Resume payload: {title, template, data}.
rca of the issue: Root cause of the crash: Express 4 does not auto-forward rejected promises from async route handlers to the error middleware. When any route hit an unhandled Mongoose error (e.g., invalid ObjectId cast in POST /api/courses/notanid/enroll, or invalid enum in POST /api/instructor/courses {level:'beginner'}), Node treated the rejection as fatal and exited. Supervisor restarted the process but every request during the ~3-5s startup window returned 502 at the Cloudflare/K8s ingress. Reproduction: `curl -X POST /api/courses/notanid/enroll -H 'Authorization: Bearer <student token>'` -> process dies. Mitigation applied: `require('express-async-errors')` at the top of server.js (patches Router to catch and forward), plus process.on('unhandledRejection'/'uncaughtException') as belt-and-suspenders. Verified: after fix, invalid ObjectId returns HTTP 500 and /api/health continues to serve 200 immediately.
